Formula Table mode here: r_l = remapValues[l,k_l], k_l counts active breaks <= x_l; score is fixed-order f32 sum 0.7*r_landCover + 0.3*r_elevation, no normalization. Land-cover breaks [20,35,45,65] map to [0.25,0.75,1,0.5,0]; elevation breaks [1100,1400,1700] m map to [1,0.75,0.5,0.25]. With propagate, any NaN/sentinel input yields NaN; a NaN remap is restricted under either policy; no contributing layers or a NaN sum also yields NaN. With ignore skip nodata layers; if normalizeWeights is enabled divide by sum(abs(contributing weights)), requiring that sum > 0.
